units.translation: I stretch out my voice, I make a long speech.
In M ἀμόμφητονδετινα τὸν λόγον [a blameless ... this speech], which Hermann and Blomfield corrected.
Intransitive: I am stretched out. ἀλκὰν – ῎Αρει [strength – to Ares] Hermann.
stretching the bow long against Alexander.
It is sweet to stretch out a long life with bold hopes.
stretching out life.
the longer life, if it is stretched forward.
for bold-mouthed men [stretch out] the long procession to come back again by force of their minds.
stretch out a hard-to-escape, mournful, crying voice.
you stretched out a long one.
and indeed they stretched out this blameless speech.
but in between, strength stretches through a little, a tower in the open.
they tremble at the stretching time.
for thick and shadowy paths of the mind stretch out.
